integrity: The ideal graph is reduced symbolically to seven exponent pairs with an exact componentwise annihilation rule. Zero forcing number and widths have explicit structural certificates, while a standalone exhaustive checker classifies all 128 subsets and verifies every polynomial coefficient.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the balanced two-prime exponent pattern p^2 q^2.
The graph and its invariants do not recover the numerical prime values.
The complete polynomial coefficients are certified by exhaustive enumeration after symbolic reduction to seven vertices.
No formula for arbitrary exponent pairs is claimed.
title: Zero forcing polynomial and width of the balanced two-prime annihilating-ideal graph
